# What will object storage cost for your GB stored and GB served, and who is cheapest?

> Enter the GB you store and the GB you serve per month and see what Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces and Hetzner charge, the 12-month spend under your growth rate, and the egress level where the cheapest provider changes. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
